translations.idiomatic: When the quotient fills the chronogram divisor, it becomes the daily degree for each.

sentences.zh: 乃以前日度盈加、縮減其合後伏度之變率及合前伏、前疾日之變率，亦以後日度盈減、縮加其後疾日之變率及合前伏、前疾度之變率。

translations.literal: Then with the prior daily degree, expansion adds and contraction subtracts from the post-conjunction hiding degree phase rate and pre-hiding and prior-swift daily phase rates; with the posterior daily degree, expansion subtracts and contraction adds from the posterior-swift daily phase rate and pre-hiding and prior-swift degree phase rates.
translations.idiomatic: With the prior daily degree, add expansion and subtract contraction from the post-conjunction hiding and pre-hiding prior-swift daily phase rates; with the posterior daily degree, subtract expansion and add contraction from the posterior-swift and pre-hiding prior-swift degree phase rates.

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury at evening conjunction, reverse the add-subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury at evening conjunction, reverse the additions and subtractions.
Station and retreat follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 其二留日之變率，若差於中率者，即以所差之數為度，各加、減本遲度之變率。

translations.literal: If the two station-day phase rates differ from the mean rate, take the excess number as degrees and add or subtract from the native slow-degree phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the two station-day phase rates differ from the mean rate, take the excess as degrees and adjust the native slow-degree phase rate accordingly.

sentences.zh: 謂以所多於中率之數加之，少於中率之數減之。

translations.literal: That is: add what exceeds the mean rate, subtract what falls short.
translations.idiomatic: Add the amount above the mean rate and subtract the amount below it.
All further adjustments follow this rule.

sentences.zh: 退行度之變率，若差於中率者，即倍所差之數，各加、減本疾度之變率。

translations.literal: If the retrograde-degree phase rate differs from the mean rate, double the difference and add or subtract from the native swift-degree phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the retrograde-degree phase rate differs from the mean rate, double the difference and adjust the native swift-degree phase rate.

sentences.zh: 其木、土二星，既無遲、疾，即加、減前、後順行度之變率。

translations.literal: For Wood and Earth, which have no slow or swift phases, add or subtract the prior and posterior prograde degree phase rates.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter and Saturn, which lack slow and swift phases, adjust the prior and posterior prograde degree phase rates instead.

sentences.zh: 其水星疾行度之變率，若差於中率者，即以所差之數為日，各加、減留日變率。

translations.literal: If Mercury’s swift-motion degree phase rate differs from the mean rate, take the difference as days and add or subtract the station-day phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury’s swift-motion degree phase rate differs from the mean rate, take the difference in days and adjust the station-day phase rate.

sentences.zh: 其留日變率若少不足減者，即侵減遲日變率。

translations.literal: If the station-day phase rate is too small to subtract, encroach by diminishing the slow-day phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the station-day phase rate is insufficient to subtract, reduce the slow-day phase rate instead.

sentences.zh: 若多於中率者，亦以所多之數為日，以加留日變率。

translations.literal: If greater than the mean rate, likewise take the excess as days and add to the station-day phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: If it exceeds the mean rate, take the excess in days and add it to the station-day phase rate.

sentences.zh: 各加、減變率訖，皆為日度定率。

translations.literal: When all phase-rate adjustments are complete, each becomes a fixed daily-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: When all phase-rate adjustments are finished, each becomes a fixed daily-degree rate.

sentences.zh: 其日定率有分者，前後輩之。

translations.literal: If the daily fixed rate has fractional parts, pair them front and back.
translations.idiomatic: If a daily fixed rate has fractional parts, balance them between adjacent segments.

sentences.zh: 以少分配多分，滿全為日。

translations.literal: Allocate the smaller fraction to the larger; when full, it becomes a whole day.
translations.idiomatic: Transfer the smaller fraction to the larger until a full day is formed.

translations.literal: Any remainder is reassigned among the other phase rates.
translations.idiomatic: Any remainder is redistributed among the other phase rates.

sentences.zh: 不加減者，皆依變率為定率。

translations.literal: Where no adjustment applies, rely on the phase rate as the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Where no adjustment is needed, use the phase rate directly as the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 置其星定合餘，以減辰法；

translations.literal: Set the star’s fixed-conjunction remainder and subtract from the chronogram method;
translations.idiomatic: Set the star’s fixed-conjunction remainder and subtract it from the chronogram divisor;

sentences.zh: 餘以其星初日行分乘之，辰法而一，以加定合加時度，得定合後夜半星度及餘。

translations.literal: Multiply the remainder by the star’s initial daily motion parts; as one per chronogram method; add to the fixed-conjunction hour-added degree, obtaining the star degree and remainder at midnight after fixed conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the star’s initial daily motion parts, divide by the chronogram divisor, and add to the fixed-conjunction hour-added longitude to obtain the star’s midnight longitude and remainder after conjunction.

sentences.zh: 自此各依其星計日行度，所至皆從夜半為始。

translations.literal: From this point each star counts daily motion; all positions start from midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter each star’s daily motion is reckoned from midnight as the starting point.

sentences.zh: 各以一日所行度分順加、退減之。

translations.literal: For each day add prograde degree-parts and subtract retrograde ones.
translations.idiomatic: Each day add prograde degree-parts and subtract retrograde ones.

sentences.zh: 其行有小分者，各滿其法從行分。

translations.literal: Where motion has minor parts, when full of the method carry into the motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: When minor parts fill their divisor, carry them into the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 伏不注度，留者因前，退則依減。

translations.literal: Hiding records no degree; station continues the prior; retrograde subtracts accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: During hiding no degree is recorded; at station continue the prior value; retrograde subtracts accordingly.

translations.literal: Prograde leaving the void: remove the six-void difference.
translations.idiomatic: On prograde departure from the void, subtract the six-void correction.

translations.literal: Retrograde entering the void: first add this difference.
translations.idiomatic: On retrograde entry into the void, add this correction first.

sentences.zh: 六虛之差，亦四而一，乃用加減。

translations.literal: The six-void difference is also quartered before use in add-subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter the six-void correction before applying it.

sentences.zh: 訖，皆以轉法約行分，為度分，得每日所至。

translations.literal: When done, reduce motion parts by the conversion method to degrees and parts, obtaining the daily position.
translations.idiomatic: Finally reduce motion parts by the conversion divisor to degrees and parts for the daily position.

sentences.zh: 日度定率，或加或減，益疾益遲，每日漸差，不可預定。

translations.literal: Daily-degree fixed rates may add or subtract, making motion swifter or slower day by day; the daily difference cannot be preset.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed daily-degree rates may increase or decrease, so motion grows swifter or slower daily; the day-by-day difference cannot be preset.

sentences.zh: 今且略據日度中率，商量置之。

translations.literal: For now we briefly set values from the daily-degree mean rates by estimation.
translations.idiomatic: For now we provisionally set values estimated from the daily-degree mean rates.

sentences.zh: 其定率既有盈縮，即差數合隨而增損，當先檢括諸變定率與中率相較近者因用其差，求其初、末之日行分為主。

translations.literal: Since fixed rates already have expansion and contraction, difference numbers should increase or decrease accordingly; first compare each phase’s fixed rate with the mean rate and apply the nearest difference to determine initial and final daily motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Because fixed rates already include expansion and contraction, difference numbers should adjust accordingly: first compare each phase’s fixed rate with the mean rate and use the nearest difference to fix initial and final daily motion parts.

sentences.zh: 自餘諸變，因此消息，加、減其差，各求初、末行分。

translations.literal: For the remaining phases, adjust the difference by message accordingly and seek initial and final motion parts for each.
translations.idiomatic: For the remaining phases, adjust the difference proportionally and determine initial and final motion parts for each.

sentences.zh: 循環比較，使際會參合，衰殺相循。

translations.literal: Compare cyclically so conjunctions align and waxing and waning follow in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Compare cyclically so conjunctions align and accelerations and decelerations follow in turn.

sentences.zh: 其金、水皆以平行為主，前後諸變，準此求之。

translations.literal: For Metal and Water, take uniform motion as primary; seek prior and posterior phases by this standard.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, take uniform motion as the baseline and derive other phases accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其合前伏，雖有日度定率，因加至合而與後算不叶者，皆從後算為定。

translations.literal: For pre-conjunction hiding, though a daily-degree fixed rate exists, if addition to conjunction does not agree with the posterior count, take the posterior count as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: For pre-conjunction hiding, even when a daily-degree fixed rate exists, if the sum at conjunction disagrees with the posterior tally, adopt the posterior tally as fixed.

sentences.zh: 其初見伏之度，去日不等，各以日度與星辰相較。

translations.literal: For initial appearance and hiding degrees, solar distance differs; compare daily degrees with the star for each.
translations.idiomatic: Initial appearance and hiding depend on unequal solar distance; compare the daily degree with the star in each case.

sentences.zh: 木去日十四度，金十一度，火、土、水各十七度皆見。

translations.literal: Wood 14° from the sun, Metal 11°, Fire, Earth, and Water 17° each—all appear.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter at 14° from the sun, Venus at 11°, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury at 17°—all become visible.

translations.literal: Subtract one degree each; all hide.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one degree in each case; all disappear.

sentences.zh: 其木、火、土三星，前順之初，後順之末，及金、水疾行、留、退初、末，皆是見、伏之初日，注曆消息定之。

translations.literal: For Wood, Fire, and Earth, at the start of prior prograde and end of posterior prograde, and for Metal and Water at swift motion, station, and retrograde initial and final—all are initial days of appearance and hiding; fix by ephemeris message.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the starts of prior prograde and ends of posterior prograde; for Venus and Mercury, swift motion, station, and retrograde initial and final days—all mark appearance and hiding; fix them by ephemeris message.

sentences.zh: 金、水及日、月度，皆不注分。

translations.literal: For Metal, Water, and sun and moon degrees, fractional parts are not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus, Mercury, and solar and lunar degrees, fractional parts are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 置日定率減一，以所差分乘之，為實。

translations.literal: Set the daily fixed rate minus one; multiply by the difference parts; this is the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: Set the daily fixed rate minus one and multiply by the difference parts for the dividend.

sentences.zh: 以所差日乘定日率，為法。

translations.literal: Multiply the difference days by the fixed daily rate; this is the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the difference days by the fixed daily rate for the divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，為行分，得每日差。

translations.literal: Dividend per divisor is one; this is motion parts—the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor to obtain motion parts—the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 以辰法通度定率，從其分，如日定率而一，為平行度分。

translations.literal: Express the degree fixed rate through the chronogram method with its parts; as one per daily fixed rate; this is uniform-motion degree parts.
translations.idiomatic: Express the degree fixed rate through the chronogram divisor with its parts; divide by the daily fixed rate to obtain uniform-motion degree parts.

sentences.zh: 減日定率一，以所差分乘之，二而一，為差率。

translations.literal: Subtract one from the daily fixed rate; multiply by the difference parts; halve; this is the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one from the daily fixed rate, multiply by the difference parts, and halve to obtain the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 以加、減平行分，益疾者，以差率減平行為初日，加平行為末日。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to uniform parts: where swiftness increases, subtract the difference rate from uniform for the initial day and add for the final;
translations.idiomatic: Adjust uniform parts: when swiftness increases, subtract the difference rate from uniform motion for the first day and add for the last;

sentences.zh: 益遲者，以差率加平行為初日，減平行為末日。

translations.literal: where slowness increases, add the difference rate to uniform for the initial day and subtract from uniform for the final.
translations.idiomatic: when slowness increases, add the difference rate to uniform motion for the first day and subtract for the last.

translations.literal: Obtain the degrees and parts traveled on initial and final days.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the degrees and parts traveled on the first and last days.

sentences.zh: 其差不全而與日相合者，先置日定率減一，以所差分乘之，為實。

translations.literal: If the difference is incomplete yet matches the days, first set the daily fixed rate minus one and multiply by the difference parts as dividend.
translations.idiomatic: If the difference does not divide evenly but matches the day-count, set the daily fixed rate minus one, multiply by the difference parts for the dividend.

translations.literal: Double the difference days; this is the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Double the difference days for the divisor.

translations.literal: Dividend per divisor is one; this is motion parts.
What does not exhaust becomes minor parts.
Then this becomes the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 置初日行分，益遲者，以每日差累減之；

translations.literal: Set the initial day’s motion parts; where slowness increases, cumulatively subtract the daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: Set the first day’s motion parts; when slowness increases, cumulatively subtract the daily difference;

sentences.zh: 益疾者，以每日差累加之：得次日所行度分。

translations.literal: where swiftness increases, cumulatively add the daily difference: obtain the next day’s degree parts.
translations.idiomatic: when swiftness increases, cumulatively add the daily difference to obtain the next day’s degree parts.

sentences.zh: 其每日差及初日行，皆有小分。

translations.literal: The daily difference and initial-day motion both have minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: Both the daily difference and the first day’s motion have minor parts.

sentences.zh: 母既不同，當令同之，乃用加、減。

translations.literal: When denominators differ, make them common before add-subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When denominators differ, reduce them to a common denominator before adjusting.

sentences.zh: 其先定日數而求度者，減所求日一，以每日差乘之，二而一。

translations.literal: If days are fixed first and degrees sought, subtract one from the sought day, multiply by the daily difference, and halve.
translations.idiomatic: If the day-count is fixed first and degrees are sought, subtract one from the sought day, multiply by the daily difference, and halve.

sentences.zh: 所得以加、減初日行分，益遲減之，益疾加之。

translations.literal: What is obtained is added or subtracted from the initial day’s motion parts—subtract for increasing slowness, add for increasing swiftness.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the result from the first day’s motion parts—subtract when slowness increases, add when swiftness increases.

sentences.zh: 以所求日乘之，如辰法而一，為度。

translations.literal: Multiply by the sought days; as one per chronogram method; this is degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the sought days and divide by the chronogram divisor for degrees.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，為行分，得從初日至所求日積度及分。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is motion parts; obtain accumulated degrees and parts from the initial day to the sought day.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is motion parts; sum degrees and parts from the first day to the sought day.

sentences.zh: 若先定度數而返求日者，以辰法乘所求行度。

translations.literal: If degrees are fixed first and days are sought in return, multiply the sought motion degrees by the chronogram method.
translations.idiomatic: If degrees are fixed first and days are sought, multiply the sought motion by the chronogram divisor.

translations.literal: If there are parts, carry them.
translations.idiomatic: Include fractional parts in the product.

sentences.zh: 八之，如每日差而一，為積。

translations.literal: Multiply by eight; as one per daily difference; this is the accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by eight and divide by the daily difference to obtain the accumulation.

sentences.zh: 倍初日行分，以每日差加、減之，益遲者加之，益疾者減之。

translations.literal: Double the initial day’s motion parts; add or subtract the daily difference—add for increasing slowness, subtract for increasing swiftness.
translations.idiomatic: Double the first day’s motion parts and add or subtract the daily difference—add when slowness increases, subtract when swiftness increases.

translations.literal: As one per daily difference; this is the rate.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the daily difference to obtain the rate.

translations.literal: Square the rate itself; add or subtract the accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Square the rate and add or subtract the accumulation.

sentences.zh: 益遲者以積減之，益疾者以積加之。

translations.literal: Where slowness increases, subtract the accumulation; where swiftness increases, add it.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the accumulation when slowness increases; add it when swiftness increases.

sentences.zh: 開方除之，所得以率加、減之。

translations.literal: Extract the square root; with the result add or subtract the rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take the square root and add or subtract the rate from the result.

sentences.zh: 益遲者以率加之，益疾者以率減之。

translations.literal: Where slowness increases, add the rate; where swiftness increases, subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: Add the rate when slowness increases; subtract it when swiftness increases.

translations.literal: Then halve; obtain the sought day-count.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the result to obtain the sought day-count.

sentences.zh: 開方除者，置所開之數為實。

translations.literal: For square-root division, set the number to be opened as dividend.
translations.idiomatic: For square-root extraction, set the number to be rooted as the dividend.

sentences.zh: 借一算於實之下，名曰下法。

translations.literal: Borrow one count below the dividend; call it the lower method.
translations.idiomatic: Place one counting rod below the dividend as the lower method.

sentences.zh: 置商於上方，副商於下法之上，名曰方法。

translations.literal: Set the quotient above; set the auxiliary quotient on the lower method above; call it the square method.
translations.idiomatic: Place the quotient above and an auxiliary quotient on the lower method—this is the square method.

translations.literal: Order the upper quotient to divide the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: Use the upper quotient to divide the dividend.

sentences.zh: 畢，倍方法一折，下法再折。

translations.literal: When done, double the square method once and fold; fold the lower method again.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, double the square method once and fold the lower method again.

sentences.zh: 乃置後商於下法之上，名曰隅法。

translations.literal: Then set the posterior quotient on the lower method above; call it the corner method.
translations.idiomatic: Place the next quotient on the lower method as the corner method.
Add the auxiliary corner to the square method.

translations.literal: Order the posterior quotient to divide the dividend.
translations.idiomatic: Use the next quotient to divide the dividend.

sentences.zh: 畢，隅從方法折下，就除如前開之。

translations.literal: When done, the corner follows the square method folded down; divide as when opening before.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, fold the corner into the square method and continue extracting as before.

sentences.zh: 五星前變，入陽爻，為黃道北；

translations.literal: For the five stars’ prior phase, entering a yang line is north of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: In a planet’s prior phase, entering a yang line places it north of the ecliptic;

translations.literal: entering a yin line is south of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: entering a yin line places it south of the ecliptic.

translations.literal: In the posterior phase, entering a yang line is south of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: In the posterior phase, entering a yang line places it south of the ecliptic;

translations.literal: entering a yin line is north of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: entering a yin line places it north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 其金水二星，以夕為前變，晨為後變。

translations.literal: For Metal and Water, evening is the prior phase and morning the posterior phase.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, evening is the prior phase and morning the posterior phase.

sentences.zh: 各計其變行，起初日入爻之算，盡老象上爻未算之數。

translations.literal: For each compute its phase motion from the initial day’s entered-line count through the old-image top line’s uncounted number.
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, count from the initial day’s entered line through the remaining counts on the old-image top line.

sentences.zh: 不滿變行度常率者，因置其數以變行日定率乘之，如變行度常率而一，為日。

translations.literal: If less than the phase-motion degree regular rate, set the number and multiply by the phase daily fixed rate; as one per phase-degree regular rate; this is days.
translations.idiomatic: If less than the phase-motion degree regular rate, multiply the count by the phase daily fixed rate and divide by the phase-degree regular rate to obtain days.

sentences.zh: 其入變日數與此日數已下者，星在道南北依本所入陰陽爻為定。

translations.literal: If the entered phase days and this day-count are below it, the star’s north-south latitude follows the yin-yang line originally entered.
translations.idiomatic: Within this day-count, the star’s ecliptic latitude follows the yin-yang line originally entered.

sentences.zh: 過此日數之外者，南北返之。

translations.literal: Beyond this day-count, north and south reverse.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this day-count, north and south reverse.

translations.literal: The Nine Planets calendar comes from the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Planets calendar originated in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 開元六年，詔太史監瞿曇悉達譯之。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan year 6: an edict ordered Director of the Astronomy Bureau Gautama Siddhartha to translate it.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 6, an edict ordered Chief Astronomer Gautama Siddhartha to translate it.

sentences.zh: 斷取近距，以開元二年二月朔為曆首。

translations.literal: It takes a near interval, with new moon of Kaiyuan 2, month 2 as calendar head.
translations.idiomatic: It uses a near interval, taking the new moon of Kaiyuan 2, month 2 as the calendar epoch.

sentences.zh: 月有二十九日，餘七百三分日之三百七十三。

translations.literal: The month has 29 days, remainder 373 of 703 parts of a day.
translations.idiomatic: A month has 29 days plus 373/703 of a day.

sentences.zh: 曆首有朔虛分百二十六。

translations.literal: The calendar head has new-moon void parts 126.
translations.idiomatic: The epoch has new-moon void parts: 126.

sentences.zh: 周天三百六十度，無餘分。

translations.literal: Circuit of heaven 360 degrees, no remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit of heaven is 360° with no fractional remainder.

sentences.zh: 日去沒分九百分度之十三。

translations.literal: Solar distance to disappearance parts: 13 parts of 900 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Solar distance to disappearance: 13 parts per 900 degrees.

translations.literal: Two months make a season; six seasons make a year.
translations.idiomatic: Two months make a season; six seasons make a year.

sentences.zh: 三十度為相，十二相而周天。

translations.literal: Thirty degrees make a phase; twelve phases complete the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty degrees make a phase; twelve phases complete the circuit of heaven.

translations.literal: Before full moon is called White Bo Yì.
translations.idiomatic: Before full moon is called White Bo Yì.

translations.literal: After full moon is called Black Bo Yì.
translations.idiomatic: After full moon is called Black Bo Yì.

sentences.zh: 其算皆以字書，不用籌策。

translations.literal: All calculations use written characters, not counting rods.
translations.idiomatic: All calculations use written numerals rather than counting rods.

sentences.zh: 其術繁碎，或幸而中，不可以為法。

translations.literal: Its art is intricate; it may chance to hit the mark but cannot serve as a standard method.
translations.idiomatic: Its procedures are intricate; it may occasionally match observation but cannot serve as a standard method.

translations.literal: Its terms and numbers are strange; at first none could distinguish them.
translations.idiomatic: Its terminology and numbers are bizarre; at first none could make sense of them.

sentences.zh: 陳玄景等持以惑當時，謂一行寫其術未盡，妄矣。

translations.literal: Chen Xuanjing and others used it to mislead their contemporaries, saying Yi Xing had not fully written out its art—this was false.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Xuanjing and others used it to mislead their contemporaries, claiming that Yi Xing had not fully recorded its procedures—falsely so.
